prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin across all kinds of change, as only one test has been completed for each category so far.
finish, new_screen changes were helpful in the initial test.
No effect was seen for adoption, redesign changes.
No effect was seen for adoption, new_screen changes.
No effect was seen for sign_in, reorder changes.
Predictions were too high for adoption, redesign; adoption, new_screen; and sign_in, reorder changes.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +6.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +0.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 77.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.2%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Pet Control Direct Reference Screen: Adds a dedicated quick control reference screen right after home intro, explaining desktop hotkeys, hiding, and chatting with the pet. (why: Support logs highlight multiple users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup, while lessons show new_screen changes in finish were effective.)
1: [home, redesign] Desktop Pet Delivery Status Card Redesign: Redesigns the waiting screen into a structured card layout featuring live progress visibility and clear desktop launch expectations. (why: Home phase mean duration is very high (2336s) and 3 support emails reported pets failing to appear on desktop or stalling.)
2: [choose_path, new_flow] Split View Onboarding Pathway Flow: Rebuilds the path choice screen using a side-by-side split layout comparing ready-made pet adoption with custom pet creation. (why: Choose path drop-off is 23.8% with a high mean time of 514s, indicating confusion between available onboarding paths.)
3: [sign_in, redesign] Account Preservation Layout Redesign: Redesigns the sign-in screen into a centered card layout explicitly explaining that signing in preserves adopted pets across app restarts. (why: The largest single support theme (8 emails) concerns pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
4: [finish, hint] Desktop Shortcut Tray Hint: Displays persistent operational advice on the final intro screen regarding desktop tray shortcuts and hiding pet commands. (why: Support received multiple complaints from users who could not figure out how to hide or summon their pet after completing onboarding.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Story Welcome Hook Copy Optimization: Updates headline, body, and button labels on the initial story screen to set immediate visual expectations. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s despite a 8s median, suggesting some users get stuck before making their first choice.)
6: [sign_in, incentive] Cloud Save Protection Badge: Adds a cloud backup badge and reassurance message to the sign-in screen to motivate account creation. (why: Sign in drop-off is 27.1% and 8 support emails cite lost pet data after logging in.)
7: [adoption, layout] Split View Friend Selection Layout: Switches the pet selection screen to a split layout view to better highlight available companion choices. (why: Adoption conversion is the bottleneck step in onboarding at 60.9%.)
8: [finish, notification] Companion Ready Desktop Notification Prompt: Enables readiness notifications and clear status hints on the home completion screen. (why: Mean completion times are high and 3 support emails reported desktop pets failing to display or open.)
